name: prooftrail
description: Prooftrail — checks your AI coding agent against the rules you set, at the end of every turn. Reads your AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md and verifies the rules that can be checked mechanically — did the tests run, did they run after the last edit, did it finish the work. Runs locally with no account needed; add a hosted judge for the rules that need judgment. Advisory: it never blocks.

SERVICE_URL.title: Review service URL
SERVICE_URL.description: Origin of the review API. Defaults to the hosted service; override for self-hosted deployments.

API_TOKEN.title: Device token
API_TOKEN.description: Paired device token. Leave blank on the host (run /prooftrail:setup instead); set this only for sandbox surfaces, whose plugin data is wiped per session.
